summary: Summary/standup store, dev.activityItems and dev.itemSummaries sources, and W9 resolvers; all with fake-db tests.

produces.name: loadOwnItems
produces.note: (db, userId, projectId, itemIds) => {id,contentHash,flagged,occurredAt}[] in itemIds order; throws Error('NOT_FOUND') for any foreign/missing/other-project id

produces.name: insertSummaries
produces.note: (deps: DevWriteDeps, userId, projectId, rows:{itemId,contentHash,oneLiner,flagged,callId}[], key) => Promise<void>; one inDevWrite, createMany skipDuplicates; empty rows is an early no-op (no transaction, so no archived/membership check when nothing is written); each distinct itemId must be the caller's item in the project else NOT_FOUND; errors CONFLICT_STATE/NOT_FOUND from inDevWrite

produces.name: createDevResolvers
produces.note: ({db, lookupArchivedMembership, requireMember}) -> keys DEV_UPLOAD_CREATE, DEV_SUMMARY_CREATE, DEV_STANDUP_CREATE, LEAD_STANDUP_LIST, DEV_STANDUP_MINE_READ; db.project.findFirst({where:{id}}) decides visibility; type DevResolverDeps
